I was concerned it wasn't able to hunt with limited vision. The fox then moved to a neighbor's yard where it curled up against the house in a sunny spot. Scratched and groomed itself until it fell asleep. Remained there for an hour or so. Unsure if spooked or if it chose to move to another location independently.
